simple.meaning: נֹקֶף (nôqeph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a threshing (of olives).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 17:6. Its contexts include kingship, Israel.
